events.title: Profusa Advances G3 Vision Labs Acquisition Conditions as Q2 Net Loss Widens
events.summary: Profusa is moving forward with satisfying conditions for its potential acquisition of G3 Vision Labs, a commercial-stage diagnostics business, despite a widening net loss in Q2 2026 and limited cash resources. The company is undertaking debt-to-equity exchanges and balance sheet restructuring to support the acquisition and meet Nasdaq listing requirements. The transaction remains conditional on G3's financial audits and Profusa exercising its option.

articles.headline: Profusa Advances G3 Vision Labs Acquisition Conditions as Q2 Net Loss Widens

events.title: AES Corp. stock holds at $14.72 as investors watch buyout spread and dividend yield
events.summary: AES Corp. stock is trading at $14.72, leaving a modest gap to a $15.00 cash proposal from an infrastructure-led buyer group. Investors are evaluating the potential annualized return of 10.7 percent by combining this spread with the company's dividend distribution, framing it as a yield-enhanced arbitrage opportunity. The analysis suggests a high probability of deal completion, supported by AES Corp.'s stable business model and long-term contracts in power generation.

articles.headline: AES Corp. stock holds at $14.72 as investors watch buyout spread and dividend yield

events.title: Aptiv stock slips after a $300 million guidance cut
events.summary: Aptiv plc's stock (JE00B783TY65) is facing pressure after the company reduced its midpoint revenue outlook for 2026 by $300 million, now expecting $12.6 billion to $12.8 billion in sales and adjusted EPS of $5.60 to $5.80. The revised forecast is attributed to weaker production schedules, delayed launches, and softer software and services sales. Despite the guidance cut, the company achieved $5 billion in second-quarter awards, reaching $10 billion year-to-date and halfway to its $20 billion full-year target.

articles.headline: Aptiv stock slips after a $300 million guidance cut

events.title: Stocks making big moves yesterday: Wendy's, Equifax, Jack Henry, PulteGroup, and Stryker
events.summary: This article highlights five companies whose stocks made significant moves yesterday: Wendy's, Equifax, Jack Henry, PulteGroup, and Stryker. Wendy's rose on news of a potential take-private bid, Equifax increased after declaring a quarterly dividend, and Jack Henry saw gains following a strong earnings report. PulteGroup's stock climbed due to an analyst reiteration of an "Outperform" rating, and Stryker's shares increased after its unit secured a large government contract.

articles.headline: Stocks making big moves yesterday: Wendy's, Equifax, Jack Henry, PulteGroup, and Stryker

events.title: Deere Shares Rise After Q3 Beat and Higher Full-Year Outlook
events.summary: Deere & Company (DE) shares rose 7.5% after the company reported a stronger-than-expected fiscal third quarter and raised its full-year profit outlook. Investors were also encouraged by management's view that 2026 would mark the bottom of the current agricultural equipment cycle. The company's net income and sales increased, and institutional investors showed significant activity in DE stock.

articles.headline: Deere Shares Rise After Q3 Beat and Higher Full-Year Outlook

events.title: Valero Energy stock hits all-time high at 351.2 USD
events.summary: Valero Energy Corporation's stock has reached an all-time high of $351.20, driven by robust performance in the energy sector, a 149.73% 1-year change, and strong Q2 earnings. Despite being overvalued according to InvestingPro, the company boasts a "GREAT" financial health rating and positive market conditions, including rising oil prices. Analysts have raised price targets following these strong results, reflecting continued investor confidence.

articles.headline: Valero Energy stock hits all-time high at 351.2 USD

events.title: Diamondback Energy stock hits all-time high at 214.71 USD
events.summary: Diamondback Energy Inc. (FANG) has reached an all-time high stock price of $214.71, currently trading at $215.07 with a market capitalization of $59.89 billion. The company's stock has seen a 55.46% increase over the past year and InvestingPro analysis suggests it is undervalued. This follows strong Q2 2026 earnings, though one analyst downgraded the stock due to valuation concerns and future spending plans.

articles.headline: Diamondback Energy stock hits all-time high at 214.71 USD

events.title: ConocoPhillips Stock (COP) Opened Up by 3.04% on Aug 20: What Investors Need To Know
events.summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) stock opened up by 3.04% due to strong second-quarter earnings, bullish analyst revisions, and a commitment to shareholder returns. Technical indicators suggest a buy signal, while the company faces risks such as leadership succession and geopolitical instability. The energy major's strategic moves and robust operational cash flow have bolstered investor confidence despite broader market fluctuations.

articles.headline: ConocoPhillips Stock (COP) Opened Up by 3.04% on Aug 20: What Investors Need To Know

events.title: Charter Closes $34.5 Billion Cox, Liberty Broadband Acquisitions
events.summary: Charter Communications has completed its $34.5 billion acquisition of Cox Communications and Liberty Broadband, making it the largest pay-TV and high-speed internet provider in the U.S. with 43.2 million customers. The parent company name will change to Cox Communications, while customer-facing services will retain the Spectrum brand. Spectrum plans to offer various benefits, including a free year of mobile service for former Cox internet customers and a full suite of products with transparent pricing to new markets.

articles.headline: Charter Closes $34.5 Billion Cox, Liberty Broadband Acquisitions

events.title: Trimble stock jumps after Q2 earnings beat and guidance raise
events.summary: Trimble Inc. (TRMB) saw its stock rise after reporting better-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings and revenue, leading the company to raise its full-year guidance. The strong performance, driven by double-digit organic growth and an increase in recurring revenue, has reinforced investor confidence. Analysts have responded positively, with one firm increasing its price target, and valuation metrics suggesting the stock may still be undervalued despite the recent rally.

articles.headline: Trimble stock jumps after Q2 earnings beat and guidance raise

events.title: Xcel Energy Rates to go Up
events.summary: The Colorado Public Utilities Commission has approved a rate increase for Xcel Energy, raising residential bills by $5 and commercial bills by $7 monthly. This approved increase is about half of Xcel's initial request and is intended to fund infrastructure improvements. Despite the company's rates having risen 22.2% since September 2023, the settlement faced opposition from various consumer advocacy groups.

articles.headline: Xcel Energy Rates to go Up

events.title: Is LSI Industries (LYTS) Overvalued After Q4 Earnings Miss? EPS at $0.18, Revenue of $234.6M -- GF Score: 88/100
events.summary: LSI Industries (LYTS) reported a significant 51% year-over-year increase in Q4 net sales to $234.6 million, with full-year revenue reaching a record $689.4 million. Despite this growth, net income was $6.9 million ($0.18 EPS), impacted by $3.0 million in acquisition-related costs, missing analyst estimates of $0.27 per share. GuruFocus indicates the stock is overvalued by 17.3% with a GF Score of 88/100, and a low predictability rank, alongside significant insider selling.

articles.headline: Is LSI Industries (LYTS) Overvalued After Q4 Earnings Miss? EPS at $0.18, Revenue of $234.6M -- GF Score: 88/100

events.title: Mettler-Toledo stock steadies after Q2 2026 earnings beat
events.summary: Mettler-Toledo International Inc. (MTD) stock is trading in the mid-$1,300s on the NYSE, supported by a Q2 2026 earnings beat where EPS exceeded analyst estimates by $0.66. Despite a slight dip in recent sessions, the stock maintains a positive year-to-date performance and is holding steady, reflecting investor confidence in its operational outperformance in precision instruments and analytical equipment. The company's consistent earnings delivery reinforces its premium valuation within the sector.

articles.headline: Mettler-Toledo stock steadies after Q2 2026 earnings beat

events.title: PSEG Launches Community Impact Update, Highlights Statewide Community Presence with $12.8 Million in Corporate and Foundation Giving and $16.3 Billion Economic Output in 2025
events.summary: Public Service Enterprise Group (PSEG) has released its 2025 Community Impact Update, detailing its significant contributions to New Jersey's economy and communities. The report highlights $12.8 million in philanthropic giving, $16.3 billion in economic output, and substantial investments in energy infrastructure. PSEG also announced a forthcoming 2026 Sustainability Report that will further explore its environmental stewardship, workforce development, and customer support initiatives.

articles.headline: PSEG Launches Community Impact Update, Highlights Statewide Community Presence with $12.8 Million in Corporate and Foundation Giving and $16.3 Billion Economic Output in 2025

events.title: Waters stock climbs after earnings beat and guidance lift
events.summary: Waters Corp (US9418481035) stock climbed to $416.45 after reporting a second-quarter beat with revenue of $1.65 billion and adjusted EPS of $3.05, exceeding expectations. The company also lifted its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $14.45-$14.65 and organic growth to 7%-9%. Analyst consensus remains a Moderate Buy with a price target of $420.35, placing importance on the execution of the new guidance.

articles.headline: Waters stock climbs after earnings beat and guidance lift

events.title: Michigan lawmakers should cap utility rate increases and give families relief
events.summary: The author, a Lansing resident, father, and grandfather, highlights the struggle of living paycheck to paycheck due to soaring utility bills, particularly from Consumers Energy. He advocates for Michigan lawmakers to cap utility rate increases, citing Consumers Energy's high revenues and executive salaries while families struggle. The article emphasizes that a rate cap would provide financial stability and predictability for Michiganders, drawing parallels to actions taken in other states like New Jersey.

articles.headline: Michigan lawmakers should cap utility rate increases and give families relief

events.title: XPO upgraded by S&P, just one notch below investment-grade
events.summary: S&P Global Ratings has upgraded LTL carrier XPO's debt rating to BB+ from BB, placing it just one notch below investment grade. This upgrade is largely attributed to the strengthening freight market fundamentals and XPO's improved financial metrics, particularly its Funds from Operations (FFO) to debt ratio. The rating agency also noted XPO's decision to insource more of its linehaul and improved operational efficiencies.

articles.headline: XPO upgraded by S&P, just one notch below investment-grade

events.title: iShares MSCI Mexico ETF lags peers despite gains in copper sector and Q2 GDP rebound
events.summary: The iShares MSCI Mexico ETF (EWW) has underperformed its emerging market and global peers this year, despite an increase in its materials holdings, particularly Grupo Mexico B, and a rebound in Mexico's Q2 GDP. The ETF's valuation shows a 16% premium over emerging market peers but with lower earnings growth. Its recent price action has lost its upward trend, suggesting a neutral investment outlook.

articles.headline: iShares MSCI Mexico ETF lags peers despite gains in copper sector and Q2 GDP rebound

events.title: Digital Realty Trust registers resale of shares issued in Columbia Capital acquisition
events.summary: Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR) has registered the resale of shares issued during its acquisition of Columbia Capital, filing a prospectus supplement with the SEC. The company, a prominent data center REIT, currently trades at $192.35, which InvestingPro analysis suggests is overvalued relative to its Fair Value. This news comes alongside recent positive analyst upgrades and increased price targets from HSBC and Cantor Fitzgerald, although Morgan Stanley noted widening credit spreads in the AI and data center sectors.

articles.headline: Digital Realty Trust registers resale of shares issued in Columbia Capital acquisition

events.title: How a proposed merger between energy giants could impact Maine electricity bills
events.summary: Maine Governor Janet Mills, along with four other New England governors, is opposing a proposed merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy. They are concerned the deal, which would give NextEra control over all nuclear power production in New England, could reduce competition and lead to higher electricity costs for consumers in the region. Governor Mills specifically cited NextEra's past efforts to suppress competition in Maine.

articles.headline: How a proposed merger between energy giants could impact Maine electricity bills
